body.text: RENDEZVOUS VECTOR / STIGMERGIC BEACON. Increase communication density without adding a supervisor or canonical owner. Derive a NON-AUTHORITATIVE compact change beacon from existing canonical state only: stable refs/digests for current WorkGraph frontier, model-usage ledger/FinancialMetabolism state, Evidence/receipt frontier, semantic-shell/Atlas contract state, and provider weather when already represented. Call it a rendezvous vector only as a derived representation. Include before/after vector refs or hashes in material mesh receipts when cheap. Another epoch should be able to tell WHAT canonical fabrics changed since its last observation without ingesting prose or duplicating state. A changed vector is a hint to re-query canonical owners, never authority. Prove one causal loop: provider/model occurrence changes usage ledger -> vector changes -> independent shell/proof epoch detects the changed coordinate -> re-derives exact canonical object -> emits review_result or trace_divergence. Do not create a new database, watcher, scheduler, event bus, or source of truth.

subject: Stigmergic rendezvous vector: communicate by canonical-state change
